features: 10000 mAh Capacity : Stay powered all day with the EnergyShroom PB300 Neo 10000mAh power bank, capable of charging your smartphone up to 2–3 times on a single charge. Its Smart Power Management intelligently distributes power to connected devices, helping prevent unnecessary energy loss.
3x Output Ports & 2x Input Ports: With three output ports (2x USB-A, 1x Type-C 2-Way) & 2 input ports (Micro USB and Type-C 2-Way), EnergyShroom PB300 Neo power up multiple devices simultaneously.
Blazing-Fast 22.5W 2-Way Charging: Experience ultra-fast charging with QC 3.0 Power Delivery, & Programmable Power Supply.
Pass Through Charging: Power up your phone while the EnergyShroom PB300 Neo itself recharges, ensuring you're never out of battery—ideal for travel & work setups.

12-Layer Smart IC Protection: Equipped with advanced 12-layer circuitry, this power bank protects against short circuits, overheating, overcharging, & over-discharging. Designed for longevity, it safeguards your devices while charging efficiently.
